title: Persist immutable replayable policy artifacts
objective: Refresh the reviewed PR #13 repair onto the exact governed integration base so each policy binding carries immutable reconstructable content and historical evaluation fails closed when that content is missing, tampered, or incompatible.
forbidden_actions: read or reuse credentials from chat
change the executable gate-policy semantics or activate a policy
change a formal Foundry Program stage, route, gate, evidence record, or checkpoint
weaken authentication, authorization, approval, audit, secret scanning, or deterministic policy controls
deploy or authorize scientific, clinical, spending, outreach, transaction, or regulated action

acceptance_criteria.description: Every new or migrated policy binding includes immutable canonical policy content whose SHA-256 digest matches its bound snapshot.
Historical arbitration reconstructs and evaluates the exact bound policy after the active service policy changes.
Missing, tampered, noncanonical, or incompatible policy artifacts fail closed.
Existing kernel, Forge contract, secret, schema-drift, and package-build checks remain green on the refreshed exact head.
A distinct reviewer evaluates the exact refreshed head and base before protected integration.

protected_actions: approve or merge the pull request
activate M0 or update a milestone checkpoint
change repository protection, credentials, policy, or a therapeutic Program record
